Property managers are allowed to list users filtered by tenant and maintenance worker roles. However, there is no validation restricting managers to only see users associated with properties they actually manage. This leads to broken object-level authorization (IDOR).

Property managers are allowed to retrieve any tenant or worker profile by ID. There is no scoping check to ensure that the target tenant or worker is assigned to a property managed by the requesting manager. This results in broken object-level authorization (IDOR).
